errors.text_span: жълтозелен за индустрия, светлосин за строителство, червен за търговия и тъмносин за други услуги
errors.evidence: The legend in the figure shows yellow for industry, blue for construction, red for trade, and dark blue for other services. The description incorrectly states 'жълтозелен' (yellow-green) for industry and 'светлосин' (light blue) for construction.
In the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' pie chart, the 'other services' sector is 12% (3.7 млн.), not 61% (19.0 млн.). The 61% (19.0 млн.) corresponds to industry.
In the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' pie chart, the industry sector is 61% (19.0 млн.), not 8% (2.4 млн.). The 8% (2.4 млн.) corresponds to construction.
In the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' pie chart, the construction sector is 8% (2.4 млн.), not 12% (3.7 млн.). The 12% (3.7 млн.) corresponds to other services.
In the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' pie chart, the industry sector is 51% (80.2 млн.), not 21% (33.0 млн.). The 21% (33.0 млн.) corresponds to other services.
In the 'TURNOVER' pie chart, the industry sector is 31% (9.8 трлн.), not 33% (10.6 трлн.). The 33% (10.6 трлн.) corresponds to other services.
In the 'TURNOVER' pie chart, the other services sector is 33% (10.6 трлн.), not 31% (9.8 трлн.). The 31% (9.8 трлн.) corresponds to industry.

errors.text_span: секторите са подредени по низходящ ред на дял във всяка диаграма
errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states that the sectors are not visually ordered by size. The machine-generated description incorrectly claims they are ordered in descending order.

The description omits the mention of the absolute values in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' pie chart for construction (2.4 млн.) and other services (3.7 млн.) in the initial summary, though they are mentioned later with incorrect assignments.
